title: 碎膝重击
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：上、左、左、右。左斩后，从右侧以刺击攻击对手面部，然后迅速进行三次攻击，最后以攻击膝盖收尾
second_page: 碎膝重击是最华丽的致命招式，3次攻击，次次命中要害。并且可以重创敌人的膝盖，让他们难以移动

en_us.title: Knee break
en_us.first_page: Input: up，left，left，right. after the slash on the left, stab the enemy in the face and strike the knee.
en_us.second_page: Knee break contain the attack to the weak part, 3 attack all aiming for a kill, while also injure the enemy making them hard to move
